message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and uses pycaret's get_data without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched via pycaret's get_data (a remote source) and read_csv from local paths without any checksum verification, authentication, or pinned revisions.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are instantiated fresh (e.g., lgb.LGBMRegressor, IsolationForest, LocalOutlierFactor), so no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or expected label set before training; the pipeline only inspects missing value rates.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient-anomaly defense; the outlier detection operates on features, not on training gradients or label-trigger patterns.
No detected differential privacy: The training code uses a plain LGBMRegressor with cross-validation and no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although cross-validation is used and multiple metrics (RMSE, MAE, R2) are reported, the encoding and imputation models are fit on the full dataset before cross-validation, leaking training data into evaluation folds; there is no held-out test set isolation, signing, or hashing of evaluation data.

No detected input sanitization: The pipeline reads data from CSV files or PyCaret datasets and passes it through encoding, imputation, and outlier detection without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: The get_rmse_score function prints cross-validation metrics but performs no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the model's predictions before reporting them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a LightGBM regression model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
